purpose: Prevent hidden warm-cache or undeclared artifact reuse from contaminating MiniMax-H3 baseline, fidelity, or practical results.

required_snapshots_per_run.pre_run_snapshot: directory existence, file count, total bytes, and optional manifest before model/container/run command
required_snapshots_per_run.post_run_snapshot: same fields after command; unexplained growth outside declared roots is a verifier failure
required_snapshots_per_run.clean_room_snapshot: required before retained speedup/quality claims; must prove cache invalidation or fresh roots
